mentions.name: Gas station loyalty points platform
mentions.description: A bespoke loyalty points system originally built for a chain of gas stations, now being launched as its own standalone platform; it serves one client so far and is transitioning from hourly billing to a monthly subscription model.
mentions.source_excerpt: Built a bespoke loyalty points system for a chain of gas stations back in 2020. Thought at first it would be a one time deliverable and then I could move on with my life. Cut to today and I'm trying to launch it into it's own platform.
